notes.title: [1.1.0.1 Patch Note] Story Mode and Challenge Mode now available！
notes.notes:
Hello, heroes!
The version 1.1.0.1 update is here, with 2 new mode unveiled. 

1. Mode Selection:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/c5ebd9bf629792bd1a0b6afc852a799eb39f6651.png[/img]

[h3]1. Story Mode - Free to go[/h3]
-Combat is relatively simple, suitable for friends who plays the game for the first time.
-In this mode, players can initially choose the "Flying Fairy" set, which helps quickly enhance attributes.
-This mode is primarily designed to allow new players to experience the game's story. The console can be activated in-game; if you encounter challenging levels or conditions that can't be triggered, feel free to modify it.
Note: This mode is relatively easy and can be modified at will, thus achievements cannot be triggered and it does not support cycle inheritance. Please keep this in mind.

[h3]2. Jianghu Mode - Mad world[/h3]
The combat difficulty is moderate, more recommended for players who have some understanding of the game.
This mode is the original game mode, so if you wish to experience the authentic gameplay, continue to select this mode!

[h3]3. Challenge Mode - Fire Hell[/h3]
-This mode features extremely challenging combat.
-It is suitable for players who are very familiar with the game's development paths and ideally have items from multiple cycles to aid them.
-Players will receive the "Flying Fairy" set at the start of this mode.
-You can obtain the "Master Gardener" set from the old monk in the south of Xiangyang City.
PS: Even with the support of these two sets, combat remains difficult, so grab your divine gear and start challenging!
Completing this mode unlocks exclusive achievements.
Recently, I had a chance to experience the Challenge Mode, and the enemies presented a certain level of difficulty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/349f8211a5804be7f97a1eff3ccb3397c06ca8a0.jpg[/img]
PS: In the initial phases, try to stay away from grassy areas; the enemies there... can be quite oppressive...

[h3]How to Activate the Console in Story Mode[/h3]
Here are some quick console usage methods and useful in-game codes:
1) How to open the console: Press the TAB key during the game.
2) To acquire items: "getitem itemID quantity” (e.g., getitem 1001 1).
PS: To delete an item, change the quantity to a negative number, e.g., -1 will decrease the count by one.
3) To increase attributes: "modiattr attribute value" (e.g., modiattr HP 9999).
PS: To decrease attributes, use a negative number, e.g., modiattr ATK -100 will reduce attack by 100 points.
4) To add traits: "gettrait traitID +" (e.g., gettrait 10127 +).

Here are some commonly used item and trait IDs :

PS:  Remember to save your game before making changes and keep a clean save file to avoid any anomalies that may affect gameplay. The addition of the console aims to enhance players' enjoyment, allowing them to experience storylines that were previously difficult to access. I hope everyone can complete the game in whatever way they prefer!
Feel free to discover more fun console codes and item/trait IDs on your own, and share your findings with one another!
Lastly, thank you to all the players! Enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle is Now Fully Released on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear players,
We sincerely thank you for your long-term support, patience, and journey with us as we finally arrive at this moment—the full release of The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle!

The full version is also now available on WeGame, Steam, and the Nintendo Switch eShop (available in Hong Kong, Korea, US, and Europe). Feel free to explore it on your preferred platform!
Watch the official release video here.

[previewyoutube=ndxElNnYwFc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's New in v1.0[/h2]
The major addition since the September EA update is the Central Plains storyline, bringing a substantial amount of new content.
For those who participated in the testing, you may have already explored much of the Central Plains storyline. Now, with both the main and side stories fully complete, we invite you to dive back in and experience the full journey that The World of Kungfu has to offer.

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]
[b]1. Feature Optimization:[/b]
- Added the option to remove kungfu at the Old Beggar on Dirty Street of Lin'an City.
- New effects for Self-created Kungfu—check out the fresh moves!
- Filtering options for Kungfu Breakthrough and Gear Enhancement.
- Added batch Sell, Pawn, and Identify options.
- New feature: Reset Enhancement.

[b]2.  New Additions and Optimizations[/b]
- Added new equipment to boost kungfu experience.
- Introduced an item that increases kungfu levels instantly.
- Added new Trait Scrolls to shops in various regions.
- Teammates from the Southern Song storyline rejoining your team will now match your level and gain additional stats and traits.
- Balanced combat values and optimized enemy kungfu and traits in the Central Plains storyline.
- You can now steal kungfu and traits from sects during challenges.

[b]3. Sect and Route Updates[/b]
- Recluse of the North Sect now grants the "North's Disciple" trait, which can greatly increase the DMG in the Stealth state.
- Clues for Confucian Inner kungfu are now available on Unnamed Island in the Prodigy of the East and Mt. Heng routes.
- Fixed issues with kungfu acquisition in various sects and adjusted Kungfu Stats. Players can reload earlier saves to regain rewards.
- Fixed rejoining issues for Southern Song storyline's teammates like Shi Yanzhang and Snowball in the Ragged Ranger route.
- Updated Little East sect's models, portraits, and stats, fixed broken kungfu and traits, and added a mysterious merchant.
- Adjusted the effects and damage of various kungfu.
- Improved the plot for Gong Moyan in the Mt. Heng storyline.
- Improved the Ragged Ranger route's plots for Nightfox Ye, Zhuhu Mou, and Mu Wanfeng.
- Refined the Feather Robes route’s romance plots, with an alternate "Mt. Hua Four" storyline available if you prefer less romance.
- Improved the interactions between Nightfox Ye and Shangguan Nan in the Street Hero route.
- Optimized Quan Buling's mischievous behavior.
- Buffed the stats of Drake, Bai Jicun, Quanzhen disciples, and Mt. Heng disciples, while slightly reducing certain stats for Central Plains teammates.

[h2]FAQ [/h2]
[b]Q1: Will my previous saves carry over after the full version update?[/b]
A:
1. Saves from the September EA update, whether from the default or beta_4_users branch, can be directly continued after the full version update.
2. Older EA saves (before the September update) cannot be carried over, as mentioned in previous announcements. Due to significant feature changes, old EA saves are not compatible. If you wish to continue playing with old EA saves, you can switch to the old EA branch.
To switch:
Go to your library, right-click The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle, select "Properties" > "Betas," and choose old_ea_version-旧EA分支 from the dropdown menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/29f43c5df7af1d1eb0a6a8a2b1e687d9bcca9065.jpg[/img]
Please note, this branch will no longer receive updates. To play new content, switch back to the default branch by selecting "None." We apologize for any inconvenience.

[b]Q2: Are there any rewards for players who purchased the game during EA?[/b]
A: Players who activated the game before 10:00 AM (UTC+8) on October 24, 2024, will find a few surprises:
1. A new NPC will appear south of Xiangyang City. Early EA players can receive rewards from this NPC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/564605c6f7cf8f213d8364efbb2a7ca4aada7fd1.png[/img]
2. Players on multiple playthroughs can also receive extra rewards, including an item that instantly boosts your kungfu level, with a maximum of 9 available.
*New players can also receive some rewards by interacting with this NPC.

Thank you, heroes, for your continued support of The World of Kungfu. We hope version 1.0 delivers an exciting experience in the world of Jianghu!

notes.title: 2024/09/13 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Both the default branch and the testing branch have been updated.

[h3]EA Default Branch Update Notes:[/h3]
-[Inheritance Fix] Inheritance NPCs can now inherit multiple items. The rules are: +1 item inherited per playthrough, with a maximum of +5. The "No Regrets" trait can provide an additional +1. In the first few playthroughs, you can rely on "No Regrets" to further increase the inheritance count. Once the maximum inheritance of 5 is reached, "No Regrets" will no longer add to the inheritance count.
PS: Fixed the issue where filtering items would cause "bad things" when inheriting items...

-[Martial Arts Fix] Fixed the issue where martial arts did not increase properly when leveling up.

-[Animal Fix] Fixed the issue where animals, such as lotus ducks, could not learn animal-type martial arts.

-[Self-Creation Fix] Fixed the issues with abnormal attributes for swordsmanship, blade technique, and insight/strength when creating self-made martial arts. If there are any issues with self-created martial arts, we can communicate and adjust at any time.

[h3]In addition to the fixes mentioned above, the testing branch also includes the following fixes and adjustments:[/h3]
- [Breakthrough Fix] Fixed the issue where damage and inner strength increased in a way that caused discrepancies when breaking through martial arts star levels. Some martial arts were dealing less damage the more they broke through.
PS: We hope everyone can test this fix together; if there are any anomalies, we will optimize and adjust accordingly.
PS: The issue where self-created martial arts had two critical damage entries.

-[New Items] Added several items to create traps in the scene for identified items. We hope you will enjoy these little things

-Fixed some martial arts and traits:
1)Fixed the anomaly with the traits of the Eastern Book Sect's 7, 8, and 9-star martial arts.
2)Fixed the issue where Hengshan disciples would recover health excessively on critical hits. Now, Hengshan disciples will recover 1% of their health on critical hits, which is a significant reduction, but still quite practical since Hengshan has many rapid-fire martial arts; each critical hit allows for recovery.
3)Fixed the issue where some wanted criminals in the Central Plains could not act, and slightly increased the attributes of some wanted criminals.
4)Fixed some abnormal entries in the martial arts collection and removed unnecessary displays of martial arts.
5)Fixed the issue where the Song Mingguang Armor would override other enhancement attributes.

-Adjusted the Four Absolutes to ignore all abnormalities; players can test this out now. The Four Absolutes can be affected by certain abnormal damage, so we hope debuff-oriented players can take them down.
-Story fix for the Eastern Book Sect where encountering Shangguan Nan was not required to recruit him directly.

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Early Access Now Supports English: Buy Now for 10% Discount!
notes.notes:
[h1]I. Current Version Overview[/h1]

[h2]1. Early Access – Experience 50% of the Full Game[/h2]

The Early Access version (EA) now [u][b]supports English and is available at a 10% discount[/b][/u]. Feel free to add it to your wishlist or purchase it directly! The EA version includes:
- 4 areas – Each one with its own sceneries, kungfu sects and local rumors to discover.
- 2 storylines – One playthrough features an immersive 20-hour narrative.
- 2 playable characters – 10 backgrounds to choose from and 14 attributes to upgrade.
- 250+ martial arts, 60+ weapons, 50 items.
- Countless NPCs can be developed into allies or taken down for loot and power.
Note: Some players may already own the EA version. After the update, the old EA saves will not be compatible due to system changes. Loading old saves may result in bugs or crashes. However, your playthrough progress will be kept to accumulate rounds. Please start a new save file. Apologies for the inconvenience!

If you want to continue playing your original EA save, you can switch to the Old EA Branch version to keep using your previous save file.
To access the original EA version:
In the Steam client, go to your library, right-click on The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle, select Properties, then go to Betas. From the dropdown menu under Select the beta you would like to opt into, choose [u][b]old_ea_version-旧EA分支[/b][/u].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/29f43c5df7af1d1eb0a6a8a2b1e687d9bcca9065.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Please note that this branch will no longer be maintained[/b][/u]. If you want to experience new content, please switch back to the default branch by selecting "None." We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

[h2]2. Official Version Coming Soon[/h2]

The official version is in the final stages of preparation. Once the release date is confirmed, we will inform you immediately! We can't wait to share it with you!
You're also welcome to participate in the technical testing of the official version. Here's how:
- In the Steam client, go to your game library, right-click on "The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle," click "Properties" -> "Betas," and enter the code: [u][b]dajianghu202408test[/b][/u]. You can then join the test branch.
This test version includes about 70% of the official version's storyline. Since it's still in testing, some storyline content is locked, and localization isn't fully polished. We appreciate your understanding!

[h1]II. Early Access Highlights[/h1]

[h3]1. Customizable Player Character[/h3]
- Customize your character's appearance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1ef8683c9d496e9bf2cb024574b2184de7eeaf95.png[/img]
- When creating a character, you can choose to randomly roll for attributes or manually assign them.

[h3]2. The More Playthroughs, the Stronger You Get[/h3]
- Each new playthrough gives you one extra Lock Count during attribute rolls, letting you secure desired traits.
- You'll also earn an additional attribute point with manual assignment for every new playthrough, making your starting character stronger.
- Both the EA and test versions carry over your playthrough count from the previous EA version for accumulation.
- Playthrough inheritance can be triggered at the Beggar Gang on Mt. Jun during EA, allowing you to continue progressing until the official version launches!

[h3]3. Character Progression[/h3]
- Characters can reach up to level 100.
- New grassland areas have been added where you can level up by killing enemies both in the grasslands and in dungeons, earning rewards like coins and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a78377bcf8b2b606cc9eb4f282de78315eb7e415.png[/img]
- After each battle, all party members gain experience, making it easier to level up lower-level teammates.

[h3]4. Mining[/h3]
- Use the Shovel in caves and dungeons to mine ores used for gear enhancement.
- You might also uncover mysterious items marked as "???". Identify these items at the City Pawn Shop—some might turn out to be rare high-tier gear!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/136dc37656586de5f21e358dd5e8b86297e55fca.png[/img]

[h3]5. Gear Enhancement[/h3]
- After reaching Xiaoxiang Area, visit Hengyang City to meet a swordsman. By completing the swordsman's storyline, you can unlock the gear enhancement feature!
- Select teammates to enhance their gear. The higher their Forging attribute, the higher the enhancement limit for the equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/5188bd0d5e5acd6f89791a08c38f27a1f49a76b0.png[/img]

[h3]6. Catch and Recruit[/h3]
- You can now temporarily recruit enemies as allies. With the Big Brother or King of Beasts traits, you can even recruit NPCs as your followers to join you in battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/08b42b240f22ce4b87625df1a42defd8930646cd.png[/img]

[h3]7. Other Highlights[/h3]
- Fast Travel: Click anywhere on the map to travel there instantly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a40e0c7ae423e2dcee98c2fe76e260932df2aa42.png[/img]

- Reset Talent Points: Before the Jiangnan Hero Contest storyline of Taihu Lake Gang, visit the Old Beggar in Lin'an City to reset your Talent Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/5008e4eea8416a16ec2ba1febf498f436e37c568.png[/img]

- New Features: The settings menu now supports 2x speed, controller support, along with keyboard support for a smoother experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/f9674e0e2403ba86f8653ec2e8d1f42f19862be2.png[/img]

- Auto-Save: Now with 8 auto-save slots. For those who dislike manual saving, this is a huge improvement!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a1afeafafa55907cb7133a775ba5d711e6bf4e6f.png[/img]
[h3][b]Take your time to explore the game![/b][/h3]

notes.title: 《大江湖之苍龙与白鸟》8月技术测试开测及温馨提示
notes.notes:
各位参与本次测试的玩家朋友们好，咱们的技术测试开启啦！感谢大家来参与本次体验测试。

[h3]测试参与方式[/h3]
所有已购买大江湖的EA玩家均可参与：请前往STEAM客户端游戏库页面，右键点击大江湖之苍龙与白鸟游戏，属性-测试版界面，在私密测试，输入代码：[b]dajianghu202408test[/b]，检查代码加入测试分支即可。 

请见此公告[url=《大江湖之苍龙与白鸟》8月14日技术测试开测！]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407450/view/4372517795041655807?l=schinese[/url]

测试版本为正式版70%的内容，特效和剧情还有不完善的地方，测试过程中可能会遇到一些异常BUG，先给大家道个歉，还希望大家多多理解测试版本的不足，感谢你和我们一起努力，一起优化后续中原篇的江湖世界！

[h3]如遇到BUG问题[/h3]
麻烦各位大侠点击游戏主界面左侧的【BUG反馈】按钮，或点此链接 https://wj.qq.com/s2/15089293/224c/ 填写提交，并欢迎加入测试群[u]826507286[/u]一起交流反馈~
关于本次测试，有一些温馨提示希望大家提前了解下~

[h3]二倍速[/h3]
【二倍速】。大家可以在进入开始界面，在设置里选择二倍速游戏，但二倍速游戏结合小丑马，可能会速度过快造成卡顿，不喜欢这种速度的朋友建议不要开启二倍速

[h3]战斗中重新选人[/h3]
【战斗中重新选人的问题】。在战斗中按ESC，或手柄START，调出系统菜单，选择重新战斗可重新选择上阵队友
1，现在提供了战斗快速保存阵容选项，有的玩家可能勾选此功能后就不知道如何替换阵容，这类情况只需要重新战斗即可
2，新增队友或限制主角上阵的情况，会重新进入战斗选人界面
3，未来我们考虑篝火或客栈更换阵容时，进入战斗时也会重新进入战斗选人界面，此功能还需要大量测试后才可以实装，未来我们测试号再考虑更新，多多理解

[h3]开发版本，会出现红色报错[/h3]
【红色报错问题】。此次测试为技术性测试，测试版本为开发版本，而非正式游戏版本，开发版本状态下，游戏遇到问题会出现红色报错，如图
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/9a2162d05d8ab55257b1179cf748195930a6003c.png[/img]

如果想要提交BUG，可以将报错位置截图（例如上图，只截取报错信息），或者打开第一个open log选项，将错误信息反馈给我们
如果想继续游戏，只需要点击第三个选项close，关闭报错就可以继续游戏。一般报错信息不会影响游戏进程，不必担心，但如果报错和异常BUG同时出现，有可能主线画面卡住音乐继续的情况，或直接画面卡死，如遇到这类情况，还希望能第一时间将问题反馈给我们

[h3]发现模型丢失，不用担心[/h3]
【模型丢失问题】。游戏过程中，可能会遇到一批金刚暴露狂，如下图，这类情况不必担心，只是游戏模型异常，这类问题可以反馈也可以忽略，我们到时候整体检查就可以
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/54d78595a859814a2ed73585bb56004c1fad4101.png[/img]

[h3]发现剧情无法触发，不必担心[/h3]
【剧情触发问题】。如发现主线或支线剧情无法触发，例如无法顺利拜师衡山、琅环阁等，可以直接将问题反馈给我们，这些剧情触发是本次测试的重点，因涉及到多路线分支，可能你所在的分支正好是我们未测试到位的地方，或者只是因异常产生的无法触发问题，咱们的剧情除大结局外已经都开发完成，未触发只是一些小异常，反馈给我们来处理，第二天应该就可以直接更新到测试版本中了

[h3]通缉问题[/h3]
【通缉问题】。游戏各城市新增了一批通缉犯，有些通缉犯的奖励非常适合前期获取，但潇湘、巴蜀、江东现在可能还有一些前置条件，如潇湘通缉需完成大青蚺后才能在官兵处解锁后续通缉，提前获取头颅也无法解锁，这类问题我们会尽早解决，让玩家未来可以在第一时间有机会完成更多通缉，不需要前置条件

[b]场景和功能不完善的地方[/b]
1，【场景无法进入问题】。少林寺，金乌王府场景未开放，部分路线主线到这里会无法进入场景，剧情也就无法触发，如发现本路线主线无法触发，可以结束测试或选择体验其他路线，感谢理解；
2，【废除武功问题】。部分功能如废除武功可以看到选项，但无法触发，因现在可能会给玩家数据造成BUG，我们测试稳定后，中原篇再开放
3，【套装组合及九宫格特组合问题】。套装系统、九宫格特性组合系统，已经实装在游戏中，但UI还没有特别优化，所以大家可能不容易发现，所以可以先不用重点体验这部分内容，但如果发现了此类功能，也希望能给大家一些惊喜
4，【自创武学问题】。自创武功可能在体验上还有一些不足之处，大家多多获取特性后再开启此功能，体验会更好一些。另外，每次修炼武功会提升武学造诣，武学造诣会直接影响大家自创武学的武功星级，如果想自创出10星武功，那需要极高的武学造诣才可以，具体大家可以多研究，有异常问题可以反馈给我们
5，【武学突破问题】。未来考虑玩家可以通过武学突破剔除特性，尤其是残疾特性，如【童子身】……，但现在大家可以看到可选择童子身，但暂时还无法剔除，未来我们会充分考虑后再来看是否可以通过武学突破消除残疾特性……，感觉有点过于逆天……。另外，修炼武功满级获得的特性多带有可突破属性，部分奖励特性或初始特性可能不可以用于突破，大家可以到游戏中发现。
6，【洗点问题】。洗点功能现在通过测试，应可以正常给主角和队友洗点，如果洗点发现异常问题，如属性降低异常，或返还天赋点过多或过少，还请及时反馈给我们，感谢感谢

[h3]一些有帮助的小技巧[/h3]
游戏中还是有一些可以提高体验的小技巧，需要的朋友们可以看一看
1，【江湖黑手】。江湖黑手等背后攻击必暴击的特性，会永久保值，尤其中原地区敌人血多防后，有此技能，背后攻击可以保命；
2，【带头大哥】。带头大哥特性可能会改变你的游戏体验。前期捕获一些类似官兵之类的NPC会比较实用，官兵有长弓术，手长攻高，可以帮助大家在前中期快速推图，推荐选择襄阳以外的官兵，会更强力。另外所有通缉NPC属性非常不错，建议重点捕获，捕获后会获得他们的头颅……，方便大家完成通缉，有点出戏，就当是……你和通缉犯找了假头颅来应付官兵的一种隐藏设定吧……
3，【好主人】。大黄狗在入队后会新增好主人特性，50%几率助攻，前期必备的好帮手。DEMO玩家已经了解，推荐给未玩过DEMO的朋友
4，【挖矿鉴定】。挖矿时除能挖到矿石及杂物外，还能挖到？？？未知的鉴定物品，鉴定物品可以找当铺老板进行鉴定（拥有玲珑眼特性的玩家或队友可以当场鉴定），鉴定后多是前期卖钱的宝物，但也可能鉴定出一些 ★ 级物品，如★ 桃木剑，★ 夜行衣，这类装备在前期没有进行装备强化时，还是非常有用的提升属性宝物
5，【潇湘开启强化】。玩家在潇湘地区便可以开放装备强化功能，部分队友会有比较高的锻造属性，可以帮助大家快速强化出+2、+3的装备，但每次强化都会提升1点锻造值，部分队友会离队，所以有限的成长是给到玩家还是队友，还需要大家多多计划
6，【击退悬崖或水域】。可以将敌人击飞到悬崖或水域，只有携带击退属性的武功才可以触发击退，条件是伤害要足够高，如打着折磨人的小兵，可以直接将其打退到山沟沟里
7，【隐身】。部分武功会携带隐身技能，如江湖主线林风眠赠予的「云体风身术」，虽然修炼条件苛刻，但战斗中使用后可以隐身，隐身可以埋伏敌人，当敌人走到你隐身的位置，会触发反击，具体大家可以多多尝试
8，推荐一些初期好用的队友
	1）【石彦章】。主线推进到江南鬼手入队后，便可以在曲家村开启临安地牢支线，地牢内可解救石彦章，但需要高道德才能收为队友，石大哥一招戏虎擒龙功秒天秒地，轻松带你飞入中原
	2）【宫莫言】。因修改了医术值影响治疗效果（甚至使用道具都会加的更多），宫莫言的五气朝元可以群体加更多的血量，但建议初期收入，中后期可能会有更强力的队友
	3）【黑无常】。强大的暗器能力和不俗的属性，低道德路线必备队友，不必过多介绍了
	4）【宫商羽】。之前EA版本特性过强了，然后……我们又进行了小幅强化，宫商羽关联后续隐藏路线，如想开启隐藏路线，建议队友多多的收进队伍
	5）【中原篇队友】。中原篇的队友普遍都极为强力，收入队伍马上就可以有极高的提升，因部分江南地区的队友会在游戏后期离队，大家可以考虑是给江南地区的队友练级，或是更快到达中原收入高级队友

具体游戏内容大家可以到游戏中体验，还有一些未提到的小彩蛋，希望能给大家带来小惊喜
希望大家能喜欢本次测试的内容，最后，再次感谢大家参与测试，体验不成熟的小版本，感谢各路江湖朋友们对大江湖的支持！

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Official Version Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players, we apologize for the [b]delay in our original plan to start testing and release in Q2[/b]. We're sorry for the inconvenience.
Based on our current progress, we expect to begin testing in August. After testing, there will be a brief adjustment period before the official version is released. Thank you for your patience!

[h2]Reasons for the Delay:[/h2]
The original EA script was intended to be 200,000 Chinese characters, with the Central Plains chapter estimated at 250,000 Chinese characters. However, the final script for the Central Plains chapter expanded to 400,000 Chinese characters, pushing the total storyline script beyond 600,000 Chinese characters (excluding skills, equipment, anecdotes, and character info). In addition to the three main storylines, various character arcs will also unfold within the Central Plains chapter. Player choices will not only influence different endings but also have the potential to reshape history. The intricate branching paths necessitate extensive debugging and dialogue refinement, contributing to the delays.

[h2]Preview of New Content for the Official Release:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/3dca5dfc165b5ab9dd7cbc5a845c9eca6206ae06.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/7efd3edcedab2c3689c3e6c7a19a1ac092caadfa.png[/img]

[b]Recommendations for the Central Plains Chapter:[/b]
1. There are 10 main storylines available, including Ragged Ranger, Feather Robe, Wulu Palace, Shaolin, Mount Heng, Prodigy of the East, Wide of the West, and Recluse of the North.

2. Each of these storylines contains hidden branches, leading to a total of 17 different endings.

3. Players can unlock the final fate of teammates in each storyline. In the Ragged Ranger storyline, players have the chance to unlock endings for all martial characters apart from the main ones. The endings for the same character vary depending on the storyline chosen.

4. Some storylines feature romantic confession plots❤, and the characters available for confession may differ slightly based on the protagonist's gender. However, for certain unconventional martial artists, gender norms may not be so rigid...

5. In one storyline, players will change the course of real history.

6. In another storyline, players can mediate between sects & forces, prevent the collapse of the dynasty, and trigger a perfect ending. A prophet at a certain ferry crossing will provide hints for the perfect storyline.

7. The scope of each storyline varies. It is recommended to start with the Feather Robe > Wulu Palace > Ragged Ranger (without joining any sect) for the first playthrough, and then explore other storylines after becoming familiar with the background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/599cfe6a2ffc0a37804aa0931bade23a49aaae8f.png[/img]

[b]Preview of New Hidden Kungfu & Traits in Each Script:[/b]
- Poor Young Beggar: Toe Stomp | Strongest Qing Kung in the Martial World
- The Orphan of Shaoshi Mountain: Great Lion’s Roar | Strongest Wine Art in the Martial World
- Mongolian Shepherd: Unauthentic Fist Punches | The miraculous kungfu that can even train sheep to be divine
- A Young Snake Chaser from Western Xia: Nine Star Staff art, seemingly more suitable for beginners
- The Runaway Forlorn Scholar of Dali: Strongest Finger Art in the Martial World
- The Abandoned Adopted Son of a Jin Nobleman: Nine Star Area Martial Art Technique
- Surviving Son of a Declining Jiangnan Family: Night to Dawn | Superior Finger Art | Trait Upgrade
- Wandering Western Novice Monk Fireworker: Tibet Blood Saber | Strongest Saber Art in the Martial World
- East Sea Fishermen Kid with Flying Flora: Pine Cone Toss | Strongest Hidden Weapon in the Martial World
- The Out-of-tune Musician in Quici Kingdom Escaping from Turmoil: Nomad Flute Song: Sands | Strongest Melody Art in the Martial World

Inheritance Between Playthroughs:
  - After the final chapter of the Central Plains, the number of inheritances per playthrough increases.
  - Each playthrough has the chance to gain additional inheritances, but there will be an upper limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a10b4c9360dd9118be2d25e5fcb6145ba9e72918.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1e68b8e2358de69f19b584bb4a19828d88acce4b.png[/img]

[b]Preview of New Teammates in the Central Plains Chapter:[/b]
In addition to the teammates from the EA version, the Central Plains chapter introduces new martial world characters:
1. Chen Sengzhi and Chen Nanxu, descendants of a noble family devastated by tragedy, searching for their lost relatives.

2. Huoshaoyun of the desert, a bandit of mixed Uyghur and Han heritage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/7655843ebc99ed8ccc566e2c6b3447cc56322bca.png[/img]
  Huoshaoyun of the desert found in the Gaochang Market, harbors a deep hatred for all martial artists from the Central Plains.

3. Utu Kunmi, the owner of the Kunmi King’s Tomb.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/71852a8adbcbc3f88ee6cf1afba8177ec6e86627.png[/img]
  Within the mysterious Kunmi King’s Tomb in the Western Regions, a blood pool formed from the blood of countless souls lies hidden...

4. The passionate youth at the Lankao Ferry: Tan Fu.

5. Even the Four Talents of Jiangnan will have their moment to shine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/8b72eabf8cadae8afa208f328dbc40a556c30fc2.png[/img]
  Every character will have a complete life story. The Four Talents of Jiangnan will continue their tales in the martial world.

6. In addition to new teammates, more followers will be available for you to recruit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/f64df41971e47985f90689b115b63a9c3a326f99.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/f0790822e3f221d6e2f1d890ffe33bca66f61b8b.png[/img]
  All of the above characters have the opportunity to join your team or become followers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/0772c23b479618a89299039aaf50082759e2edf7.png[/img]

[b]Separated Aspects[/b]
In the Central Plains chapter, you will reunite with an old friend along with the Ragged Brother. The old friend mentioned that you and Wanyan Yong were Separated Aspects who would never see each other again. Now, at this crossroads, your paths may lead to an uncertain future.

*Separated Aspects: "the incompatibility of Shen and Shang stars." This phrase originates from ancient Chinese astronomy and literature, specifically referring to the stars Shen (Orion) and Shang (Antares). These stars are noted for their astronomical opposition: when one rises, the other sets, symbolizing separation and discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/80d18eeebe33ca94c0957b98815beb6026e6bf39.png[/img]

The official demo is now available on Steam. You can download it directly, for the trial process, please refer to the previous announcement.
Next, we'll prioritize optimizing the storyline and performance of the official version, aiming to start testing and launch as soon as possible!

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Demo is Now Live on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h3]Embark on your adventure in The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle with our official trial demo! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a963a32566a72c915af117643c900b185ef80639.png[/img]

[h3]Here's how you can dive in:[/h3]
1. [b]If you haven't purchased the Early Access version, you can download the demo directly from the Store Page.[/b]
2. If you've already purchased the Early Access version, and you encounter issues when trying the demo, please contact us at info@chillyroom.games

[h3]Suggestions for playing the demo[/h3]
[b]- Resolution[/b]
For an optimal DEMO experience, we suggest opting for a 16:9 screen resolution. Ahead of the official release, we'll fine-tune compatibility for other resolutions, including 16:10 and ultra-wide screens. Additionally, while controller support isn't currently available in the demo, we're actively working on enhancing controller and keyboard shortcut functionality for the full release. 

[b]- Language[/b]
Simplified Chinese is currently the only language supported in the game's EA version, but the full release will also support Traditional Chinese and English. Stay connected with us on social media for any updates.

[h3]The Demo Features:[/h3]
1. [b]The Xiangyang area[/b] to explore! The main storyline concludes after the battle at the inn in Jiangxia, but exploration remains open after the storyline.

2. [b]6 Wanted Quests[/b]
  - After completing the White Impermanence storyline, you can unlock 6 new wanted quests by visiting Sheriff Li of Xiangyang.

3. Character Progression
  - [b]Character level cap at LV.100.[/b]
  - Customize your player character's initial stats by [b]allocating points[/b] to STR, AGI, etc, and choosing up to 3 traits. Alternatively, leave your points and traits to chance and let destiny take control!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/d8ddcae2afccae3e2dc6a7bc2c07328fdbad286f.png[/img]

  - [b]Traits[/b] are equipable effects that boost your character's certain attributes while reducing another.
    - Earning yourself a title in the World of Kungfu grants you corresponding traits. Different titles provide [b]additional attribute bonuses[/b], and titles can be changed or removed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/86c51f4fb54958d051541f884a55de03bfbdd751.png[/img]

  - [b]The more you play, the stronger you get[/b]! Per playthrough, you gain an extra point for allocation and 1 extra Lock Count (which prevents an attribute from changing during a re-roll).

4. [b]Portraits[/b] of main characters. Portraits of main NPCs will be added in official version 1.0.

5. [b]Illustrated Handbook[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/71817a37d4b865d6f3b0986927acf55ef01cb791.png[/img]

6. [b]Compendium[/b]
The Rumor Compendium aids in understanding the World of Kungfu's lore and history.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/26018e2f4baa0a96732f6a31d80bea44cb4ce340.jpg[/img]

7. [b]World Map[/b]
Clicking on any location allows for fast travel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/212d9db3302c1678508c23b865473bdb2af00259.png[/img]

8. [b]Followers[/b]
  - Enemies under special conditions can aid your side for a set number of rounds during battles.
  - If you have specific items and initial traits, certain enemies have the potential to become followers after battles.
  - Recruiting certain followers grants your character special traits, enabling your followers to frequently trigger assist attacks during battles.
Note: Apart from those met while completing the main storyline, all wild enemy creatures and animals are eligible to become followers, with attributes randomized.

9. [b]Combat System[/b]
  - You can encounter random battles anywhere on the map, whether in a maze or grassland, where you might unlock a special side quest or hidden NPCs!
  - Feeling intimidated by the enemy? No worries, you have backup plans - rebattle (by pressing ESC) or flee.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/459d3d598d506882921c508cab5d992b210700ae.jpg[/img]

10. [b]Unique Combat Mechanics and Features[/b]
  - Unique effects such as dizziness, blindness, and fear can be inflicted upon your enemies during battles.
  - Knockback distance is proportional to damage dealt; critical hits can significantly push enemies back.
  - In the battle, enemies knocked into water drown instantly.

11. [b]Mining[/b]
  - Explore cave mazes to mine ore, which can be used for future equipment upgrades.
  - Rare discoveries during mining can be pawned for valuable items and coins.

[h3]The Official Release 1.0 Features:[/h3]
1. [b]Character Portrait System[/b]: Customizable Appearance
2. [b]Equipment System[/b]: Set Bonuses
3. [b]Trait System[/b]: Chain Boost
Wherein having 3 traits in the same row or column triggers an additional bonus trait.

notes.title: Development Updates 12/22/2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1230f9e6f98c46885388a659738a556c04a5032a.jpg[/img]
In the past few months, we've been reviewing plots, adjusting numerical values, and working on other miscellaneous tasks... And here are all the recent updates we can't wait to show you guys. Come take a look at what new content has been added to The World of Kungfu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/890521e61f605e8217ee37c7390da89c9bf51015.png[/img]

1. In the official release, the max level will be raised to Lv.100 from Lv.20 in the EA. Simultaneously, character attributes such as STR, AGI, and STA will also increase from a maximum of 25 to 30.
*P.S. The random addition of attributes will perhaps be removed from the final release, as we noticed that it confused players.
2. It might worry some of you that this leap of level caps will cause a waste of attribute points. However, it's hard to max out on every attribute in the first playthrough, since higher attributes still require more attribute points. Players can still enjoy careful planning when allocating the points ;)
*P.S. Teammates with low levels but high talents are highly recommended for enhancement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/5549c2c2c9845527d2c52153e8c2109a30d65beb.png[/img]

1. The controller support is now under development. In the future, The World of Kungfu will support PS, Xbox, and other controllers to the best of our abilities.
2. All the UI in the following screenshots are controller-supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a86d5098597fce546d5d3851783478ef5a2242a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/33e12c714db1600bbef43f87f5b54ed9f45e6816.png[/img]

1. In the character creation menu, players can customize their faces, costumes, and accessories of their portrait and sprite.
*P.S. We're still working on the portraits available for players. (On the pic it's Wu Yansi, a nobody eunuch who got lucky to be chosen as the "poster boy" here... Well, fortune favors the prepared.)
2. Unlock hidden costumes and accessories with multiple playthroughs.
3. Here's a piece of the custom sprite feature. Note that this feature has a long way to go...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/4028d1fbc92b9dd93dcb252f7be8d629f5dc0204.gif[/img]

4. Also, you must have noticed that we added color sliders for customization enthusiasts! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/12bb5aab848c8cac19bda614f43786f91ba8d1fb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/de0892ff8c4fe1519bb9f6ca166a0abe2804f304.png[/img]

In addition to the previous roll design, we added a new design. Players can choose whichever design they favor more.
Mode I: the original design with a new lock feature, which allows players to pin down stats and traits randomly generated. 
*First-time players will have 1 lock, and as they finish each playthrough, they will get an additional lock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/b8af6dc4aa9cae50e931ecb5ff651cf304497ce1.png[/img]

Mode II: the allocating design allows players to allocate the points to talent stats (e.g., STR, AGI) as they want. Basic stats (e.g., HP, MP) and talent skills (e.g., Sword, Wine Art) are fixed. 
Also, players can select the traits from the nine-grid (which will be further introduced down below). 
*Players gain 1 stat point from each completion of playthroughs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/920b250ade22f0a26e4fba2fb2ca2c5953b2ee5e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/e8f2ce5fddafd0b4bb6a32ce528a7b2d6461d7bc.png[/img]

1. Players will be able to collect Kungfu, Equipment, and Teammates.
The Kungfu collection is categorized into Sword, Saber, etc. so that first-time players can quickly get an overview of the Kungfu classes. In addition, players may learn how to unlock Kungfu from NPCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/33f819e69ba1cbebc74b438d261e7ddc91f384d7.png[/img]

We encourage every player to complete the full equipment collection (as it's not that hard!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/9818f6506d152f7d73ec4012066c1f48b9239837.png[/img]

Players will meet different teammates as they go with different routes. Complete the collection with multiple playthroughs, or...turn a master traitor that adeptly navigates between sects within one playthrough. Still, it's not an answer to achieve a full collection, as you won't be able to unlock all the teammates with the traitor route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/552a9453e389ade846c010fc42cfa207eb3eb5b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/dbacde285a7841998818c9e652c41f9d1ccfb3e2.png[/img]

1. In the official release, players can collect mythical Jianghu sets. Put on three pieces of a set to activate the set buff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/2119c32f248aace5dba3d6ad907ce037338c1862.png[/img]

2. Some set buffs are just perfect matches for certain low-level Kungfu, transforming them into top-level Kungfu that can even rival Divine Kungfu.
3. Many pieces of equipment that players may have collected in places such as Jiangnan and Xiaoxiang areas when playing the early access version are probably from a myth set. Don't overlook the least shiny equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/dc22207ed8c581d0fd95a41757051121c232b3c7.png[/img]

1. Previously, we've unveiled the feature of capturing NPC as your teammates. Captured teammates can be selected as companions.
*Open the selection menu, and select companions from the list:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/052016cd3e885e9a151261049ba2d2d236ab302c.png[/img]

2. After you join a sect, Jianghu teammates will leave your team, but companions follow you...forever.
3. NPC Capture 101:
  a) Use Jianghu Favor Orders rewarded from special city bounties to capture (or persuade, if you prefer) human NPCs. But governments rarely issue Favor Orders.
  b) Use rare items collected from certain cities to capture animal NPCs.
  c) Several special traits including "Born to Lead" and "King of Beasts" allow players to persuade enemy NPCs during battles with probabilities. If successful, NPCs will be captured after battles.

*Added a feature that allows players to check out NPC's stats during battles, e.g. STR, AGI, and STA. We're considering expanding the range of information available here. Some NPCs have randomly generated stat, so make it a habit of checking NPCs out to never miss out on a "Shiny Hoothoot".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/abdc5a38c8d9eb1eee341cc8418f6399330ec0ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/3e5949a4ea0366bbd55d98131996b7238dcdd5ad.png[/img]

We received some feedback on the unclear labels shown in the backpack menu, so we've re-designed the labels, added a feature of showing the item's name by long-pressing it, and developed further the filters.
If you have any suggestions for a better backpack, please feel free to share them with us!
*Find stuff easier:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/66fb37bfb505d4e480d8d6df0aaff7486733846f.png[/img]

*Long-press to show the item's name:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/99acd36077db87ce7743e70881bc900c281de8cd.png[/img]

*Better filter features, also available for equipment and Kungfu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1734b0f45b9564388be6aa54e62d546f35bf723a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/80699d912eab1b04c7ca85b51731ad368fb9307e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/2685840f8e67a37c92c0baf16ee431e04ab9c6dc.png[/img]

1. Traits like Taihu Hero, Qingcheng Hero, and Southern Hero will become titles. Each character can only have one title, but the stats buffs of titles are increased greatly.
2. Added a nine-grid for traits:
a) Traits are classified into type I, II, III...to IX, plus type null;
b) Traits can only go into their designated slot;
c) But type null can fit in any slot;
d) Traits that relate to the body (e.g., "virgin" or ones that associate with disabilities) are not removable or replaceable once selected when creating the character. But the stats buffs are increased greatly, and certain Kungfu may benefit from traits of this kind. So think twice (or more times) before deciding your mind.
e) Chances to acquire different types of traits from cultivating corresponding star-levels of Kungfu. Also, players can learn rare traits from fulfilling some NPC's requests.
3. Traits learned progressively from cultivating a certain school of Kungfu may trigger chain buffs. As shown below, the traits of types 2, 5, and 8 (highlighted with bright yellow) trigger a Taoist chain effect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/af8e8627b7badab2b7704d7942dc1aaf6e78b4b2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/e56eaeb51511215307e95f6af8b4178845347c3e.png[/img]

1. In the official release, players can go to the Blind Blacksmith, an NPC in the mythical Xiaoxiang Areas, to unlock the equipment enhancement feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/5dd8100448866c64ddff1e5754ac1108c81c9674.png[/img]

2. Different ores offer different attributes for equipment:
a) Ores can only enhance existing attributes if the equipment already has four modifiers;
b) If not, ores can add a new modifier to the equipment.
3. Added the character stat "forge":
a) The max level of equipment enhancement depends on this stat; caps at +10;
b) Different traits, equipment and forging places may combine to different enhance outcomes.
4. High forging stats won't lead to excessive equipment stats, and ores are generally not rare. This feature aims for players to have fun experimenting with combinations of ores and equipment.
5. Enhancing some equipment to +10 may result in "Descent of Artifact" (shown at the top of the screen when it happens, as presented in the screenshot below). There are already many artifacts in EA.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/b0b05b1bf9dd2aad4ce890b12e25a7e472811a57.png[/img]

6. After the equipment reaches +10, the modifiers can be refined:
a) Players can replace all added modifiers;
b) Special modifiers for the fifth slot offer skill stats such as increasing the chance of successful poisoning;
c) Refining equipment costs Meteorite Fragments, which are very rare. Players can only find several of them in the whole world of Kungfu, so remember to keep a sharp mind when using them.
7. Players can reset enhanced equipment at the Blind Blacksmith's place.
8. Ores can be spotted from the world map, caves and mazes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/39c7bdd778ac6bf4fefd8ff125404893b159d276.gif[/img]

a) Ores can be specific to areas. Find the ores you need in their born places. Ores will automatically reappear in caves and mazes after a certain period.
b) Use a shovel to mine, and players may also find mysterious pots when mining ores. Take them to pawn shops in cities for appraisal:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/b819ef27d52b12d1fb44be98d42914e31d165978.png[/img]

*Some pots are authentic antiques, while others are as fresh as last week's pottery. Pots can be sold, so players can earn travel expenses through mining in the beginning. Players may also find rare treasures and scriptures when mining. Some scriptures are even critical for learning 8-star or 9-star Kungfu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/72f6e7665db361d863cb236f30c328d809594934.png[/img]

1. In the official release, we've added a stat "Kungfu". This stat increases with each level-up of Kungfu. The higher the stat, the more likely the Kungfu you invented is of higher damage or star-level.
2. Players will unlock two features, Kungfu Invention and Kungfu Breakthrough, after defeating the enemies in Central Plains again.
a) Kungfu Invention. Unlock the options in the nine-grids and invent your own Kungfu. First, choose a class and a pattern to set a foundation for your Kungfu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/0f2d3df338f7e59f78ca399db578256a7b886323.png[/img]

You can also choose a visual effect that suits your Kungfu the most:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/f6112bfdc6323eac689d82054d7186b4f573b615.png[/img]

Also, the character's trait nine-grid provides buffs to your invention:
- Type II and IV traits relate to the shoulder, increasing base damage, damage increases per level, and NP cost, etc.
- Type VI and VIII relate to the legs, increasing the chance to stun enemies, or increasing damage based on the character's Qing Kung level (a Kungfu with high agility), etc.
- Type I, III, VII and IX offer attributes per level, and provide special effects such as damage range +1.
- Type V sits in the center of the grid, deciding the school, such as Taoist or Buddhist, level and star-level.
2) Kungfu Breakthrough. Successful breakthrough increases the damage, level and star-level. 
For example, Extant Dragon Palms is only an 8-level Kungfu for missing three moves. If players can recover the three moves from breakthrough, the star-level should be increased without a doubt.
Kungfu with higher potential is more suitable for breakthroughs.
First, choose the Kungfu you want to breakthrough:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/15dba986edc6804d4f20e086b96b3e59b246cd5b.png[/img]

Next, choose four traits. Please note that the four traits chosen for the breakthrough will be removed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1acdc2ce9a8834356c5c72a78dca8fcfd8c6fcfe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/8cfd7052c4a4fe289d0e40ba8b4fe572e2fccd47.png[/img]

Descent of Divine Kungfu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/ac62691cc5a18ee1aa6d98dd48da9c08568a0f45.png[/img]

Divine Kungfu refers to 10-level Kungfu. Kungfu can become Divine Kungfu with breakthroughs, and will thus be marked as divine:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/15f818390fc8ed61553a94cfc329ca8d8d0b6b7d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/6fcffb11198b54b140344e849f779624e1ceba03.png[/img]

We've also made various attempts to create distinctive characters. Here are some drafts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1bd63c257ff39cf0859e46c66baa95bb3164e44e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/29d9c03475395b249ce504a99e031c77a1b497b4.png[/img]

New Jianghu stories and characters are coming up in the official release.
We also met challenges in designing certain characters, as we wanted them to be iconic and fit their stories perfectly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/eb4c4abfe5482aa3594736860c681ee6d9095825.png[/img]

Well, we know that you're eager for the portrait of Nightfox Ye, but we decided to do this later, as we hope to give our all in designing her when the time comes!
The design process has had its ups and downs, yet it's all worth it. In the end, we aim for the best effects of illustrations and narratives for all the players to immerse themselves in the complex relations, love and hatred between the Jianghu characters. 
Even though it has taken a considerable amount of time, we hope to provide everyone with an immersive and rich experience in the vast world of Kungfu!

And finally, if you're interested... The background image in the Kungfu Invention menu takes its inspiration from the Suzhou astronomical chart, engraved on stone between 1078 to 1085 (during the Northern Song Dynasty). It is said that the chart was drawn by Huang Shang, a renowned literary figure and poet during the Northern Song Dynasty, also known as Mian Zhong (his zi, "字"), Yan Shan and Zi Xuan Weng (his hao, "号").

This is still subject to verification, and you can do some research if you're interested.

Also, we attach a wallpaper featuring Grandmaster Freewings of Kongtong Clan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1a9237ede706c497f21b2fe225c2b3691eaae6de.png[/img]

The illustration draws inspiration from a classic film character. Can you recognize who it is?

Finally, wishing all of you a year brimming with prosperity, good health, and genuine joy.
We will see you in 2024!

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Set to Launch in English Version by Q2 2024
notes.notes:
The game will present a vast story spanning 10 years with a cast of over 100 characters. Its Early Access version covers the first half of the epic saga (with Chinese language support only), and more is to come in the full release coming next year.

We're working on the full release with a focus on refining the storyline for each sect and key character. As we approach the finale of our [i]Jianghu[/i] story, the main characters' arcs will be tied up in a way that will be sure to pack an emotional punch.

[h1]Join Us at Pax West 2023![/h1]
We're excited to announce our presence at Pax West this year! Join us at booth number 659 from September 1st to September 4th to experience the debut of our English demo.

[h1]... And the Latest Scoop of the Full Release[/h1]

[h2]More Stories: Be the Master of a Wulin Sect[/h2]
In the full release, players should be able to join any of the 9 sects and gangs including Shaolin, Quanzhen, and Mt. Heng. Each sect has its unique story to uncover, exclusive martial arts to learn, and special companions to recruit. Players can leave their sect after joining, though [b]leaving might bring hefty consequences.[/b]

[b]Some sects offer an evil storyline branch[/b], allowing players to murder their shifu and establish their own name.

[h2]Bigger World: An Extended Map[/h2]
Besides the 4 areas of the south in the EA version, the full version will encompass the Central Plains, Northern Desert, and West Regions.

Central Plains
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/4e2eba8e289a8767dfecce70b1a787a85896cacd.png[/img]

Northern Desert
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/3351f595ed391fcd563f40fe041d322915be052d.png[/img]

Western Regions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/efaaf05e44a831886dd0e2490d0a3fb9097ca54b.png[/img]

[h2]Character Portraits[/h2]
Currently, we're creating character portraits for all the NPCs that players can come across in the game, including both key characters that play significant roles in your adventure, as well as less relevant NPCs like random men and women you meet in the street.

Portraits of all potential companions and other key characters will be meticulously illustrated to reflect their persona. Even for the same character, new appearances will be unlocked as the story progresses.

[h2]Functional Improvements[/h2]
You'll see a more [b]diverse combat mechanism[/b] in the full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/e3ac5cd72cc714066f7bff295b25363efc162349.gif[/img]

Non-Linear Attack Range

[b]The achievement system is in the debugging phase[/b] and will also be included in the full release if development progresses as expected.

各位喜欢大江湖的朋友们，工作室定期诈尸日志来喽~

[b]【四书飞剑小毛桃】：[/b][i]接下来就由小毛桃我来给大家介绍中原篇的情况[/i]

[h3]【东书】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/2a0f5851a5d657f752e0d3ff8e62ad21b8dd721f.png[/img]
[b]入门条件[/b]：江湖路线，儒家武学根基，「特定队友」入队

[h3]【北孤】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/87f6f8b9e96b2ee9bb774a6373921b860c011c94.png[/img]
[b]入门条件[/b]：江湖路线，「一本特殊的剑法秘籍」
[b]门派特色[/b]：最强剑法
[b]门派队友[/b]：大丑雕
[b]门派简介[/b]：北孤一生傲视群雄，却发现最适合与他一较高下之人已被他错过……晚年创出绝世剑法欲传后人。需提前获得固定剑法秘籍才可开启北孤独孤涉隐藏路线

[h3]【西博】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/4e2eba8e289a8767dfecce70b1a787a85896cacd.png[/img]
[b]入门条件[/b]：江湖路线，邪门武学根基，道德≤5
[b]门派特色[/b]：擅长剑、掌、指、特的武学、擅长用毒、走火入魔等异常状态引爆，将走火入魔的敌人变为己方
[b]门派队友[/b]：琅环三老，？？？
[b]门派简介[/b]：西博将成为中原篇最重要的关键人物，影响整个武林，而其和你有着特殊的师承渊源……
[i]PS：南婆由于有了关门弟子木挽风将不会再收徒弟，但会以特殊武林前辈身份指引玩家，如协助羽衣四侠提升武学等[/i]

[h3]【少林】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a310065612471b5ff88413711c10e319b6314261.png[/img]
[b]入门条件[/b]：江湖路线，佛家武学根基
[b]门派特色[/b]：高防御、高低属性影响伤害，易筋洗髓改变属性，铁布衫霸体免疫N次连打伤害
[b]门派队友[/b]：空空大师、苦智小沙弥、苦能小沙弥等
[b]门派简介[/b]：少林寺将成为整个大江湖故事的最终战场，而少林三位长老也将迎来艰难的选择……

[h3]【衡山】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/ca4a733512af124087f9e6cbc6e7d8324fdae7b8.png[/img]
[b]入门条件[/b]：江湖路线，道德≥15，宫莫言加入队伍
[b]门派特色[/b]：擅长剑法、掌法，音律武学，武学高连击、连打增伤，克制音律武学
[b]门派队友[/b]：衡山五侠
[b]门派简介[/b]：衡山掌门宫衍行将成为中原篇某条路线的关键人物，同时宫掌门也在头大五个弟子都不愿继任掌门的事情，而这个历史重任不知要落在谁的头上……

[h3]【全真】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/dcd6152d6a7155769c66b90662c3154b2d3aaaac.png[/img]
[b]入门条件[/b]：江湖路线，道家武学根基
[b]门派特色[/b]：擅长剑法、掌法、指法、治疗，擅长清除异常状态，净化敌方增益状态，克制邪门武学及异常状态
[b]门派队友[/b]：全不灵、君宜辅等
[b]门派简介[/b]：在中原篇屡屡受挫，意志消沉的王害风在钟南山顿悟入道，万古长夜是否能再度重阳？

[h2]二、中原篇的新势力[/h2]
[h3]【羽衣四侠】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/027be669ea86ffad98abecad64bea22670814459.png[/img]
[b]特定路线[/b]：羽衣路线
[b]武学特色[/b]：擅长剑法、刀法，暗器，羽衣四侠也将在各派触发羽衣路线限定武学
[b]门派队友[/b]：羽衣四侠、吴延嗣
[b]门派简介[/b]：羽衣四侠白鸟折翼的故事还将继续，羽衣路线相对于其他路线，拥有比较多的剧情，喜欢羽衣线的朋友们也将揭开羽衣四侠最终的宿命结局。四侠逆风而行，不知他们是逆天改命，一跃登顶武林；还是化为尘埃，泯灭于江湖……
[i]PS：羽衣路线特定选择下可能会脱离羽衣路线，进入江湖路线[/i]

[h3]【金乌王府】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/3351f595ed391fcd563f40fe041d322915be052d.png[/img]
[b]特定路线[/b]：江湖路线，玩家有机会在中原篇初期加入金乌王府，背弃整个中原武林
[b]武学特色[/b]：擅长刀法，掌法，特殊武学，擅长吸血、嗜血狂暴等特殊状态，擅长色诱、召唤等特殊武学
[b]门派队友[/b]：胡漠北、蒲古里六、灵踪禅师、何文若、药王神姜近九、胡姬祝虎谋
[b]门派简介[/b]：同羽衣路线一样，喜欢破庙师兄的朋友们，将迎来金乌王府路线，玩家将以一人之下的身份，以金人朝廷的视角重新审视整个武林，被列入宋金辽史的大金，是否能「吾修文物，彬彬不异于中华」？破庙师兄和你互为「参商之相」，你们会成为风雨对床的知己，还是会成为互相利用的仇敌？

[h2]三、还有一些其他门派……[/h2]
[h3]【西域神秘门派】[/h3]
[b]特定路线[/b]：江湖路线，玩家有机会在西域加入神秘帮会组织
[b]武学特色[/b]：擅长剑法，刀法武学，擅长各种毒火及爆炸陷阱，同时还可能收买或招募山贼流寇成为队友
[b]门派队友[/b]：???
[b]门派简介[/b]：西域龙门客栈集各地神秘人物，你将与一位江湖知己成为他们的领袖，带领神秘帮会成员参加中原武林大会，问鼎江湖！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/12505000d2555767d9889414ff7b28ae35c01dd2.png[/img]
[b]【四书飞剑小毛桃】：[/b][i]江湖上有废除武功（及附带特性）以及为江湖大侠洗点的人，花点小钱就可以办妥[/i]
[b]【四书飞剑小毛桃】：[/b][i]进入各个门派，可随时叛变，但门派部分特性将会被掌门收回[/i]
[b]【四书飞剑小毛桃】：[/b][i]还有其他各门派的事情，想起来再跟大家念叨[/i]
[b]【四书飞剑小毛桃】：[/b][i]小毛桃就为大家介绍到这里，在雁荡山大概率已被你噶了，可能无缘和大家在中原篇见面[/i]

希望中原篇，大家能体验到一个剧情、武学、数值都相对比较完善的版本，而不是一个比较赶工的版本。而且希望中原篇的大江湖能在不同周目间都有不同的剧情及武学组合体验。

同时上次的战斗视频公告后，我们又增加了一些新的战斗逻辑，希望能增加例如EA版酒艺流之外等再多一些的武学流派玩法，而且我们也梳理了战斗公式及各状态公式，避免中原篇的战斗出现后期秒天秒地的情况。

正式的上线时间现在还不好确定，团队四人一直在全力开发，现在主要耽误时间的还是大量的剧情分支处理，各门派的剧情以及各门派之间的交叉逻辑，需要多一些时间调试。

希望大家多多理解，我们制作组和大家一样，同样是天下第一急急大王，急啊~
一首小诗与君共勉
[b]「酌酒与君君自宽，不如高卧且加餐」[/b]
改日再叙！

notes.title: 大江湖之苍龙与白鸟开发日志-0130
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/1230f9e6f98c46885388a659738a556c04a5032a.jpg[/img]各位喜欢大江湖的朋友们，工作室定期诈尸日志来喽~
一些新进展和大家唠唠！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/2e03f2d96361d2372fa188207af858ecb59ee108.png[/img]
[h3]一、工作室进展：[/h3]
1. 项目组[b]从2人扩展到4人[/b]，新加入了美术&程序同学各1名
2. 从EA上线至今，开发进度每天都在正常推进，[b]没有~受到~任何~影响~[/b]！

[h3]二、正在开发中的功能：[/h3]
1.【等级提高】：未来会有更多的等级及天赋天数，属性养成依然需要取舍
2.【天赋洗点】：玩家任务、道具、加点属性返还，变成天赋点数，[b]可重新加点[/b]
3.【武功遗忘】：遗忘时，武功附带的攻击、气血、剑法、刀法等属性也会全部遗忘，类似于自废武功，但部分邪门歪道的门派遗忘武学时可能会保留部分属性；
4.【战斗中增加特殊地形，增加新的战斗特性、武功、装备附加效果】，希望正式版本能让大家有更多的玩法组合的乐趣，同时也会邀请我们凉屋有经验的同事一起参与战斗流派&功法组合的设计

[h3]三、系统优化：[/h3]
1. 所有界面UI调整，未来可支持更多分辨率设置
2. 手柄适配，未来[b]可支持手柄操作[/b]

进度一直正常开发，除此外还有一些诸如框架扩展等比较耗时的工作，另外版号工作也一直在进行中，毕竟，国内，还是，需要……

有朋友可能会问，既然开发了上面的功能为什么不更新到现有EA版本？原因是正式版本的内容和框架相较于现有EA 版本会大幅提升，在没有更多新内容支撑下，小的功能优化更新很难激起玩家想要重打一周目的兴趣，同时，双版本维护一定会耽误正式版的进度开发，希望大家能理解。

对于上面的进度，其实制作组也希望能先不对外透露，我们甚至从没有把上面任何信息透露给每天都在私聊我们的QQ群小伙伴们。制作组希望能全力开发正式版本，等到玩家上手正式版时能有更多惊喜。
但确实不定期冒泡，很容易被误会：
自1月10日至今，我们收到10几条差评，其中12条都是非常确定的：制作组跑路……

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/e988d63113aa1a7bdc6d62c414432d8a06f99ba9.png[/img]
玩家们好，
大江湖工作室漫宝儿和5B大叔已经正式加入凉屋游戏。
[b]欢迎大家加入大江湖凉屋新游戏群：680207749[/b]
原大江湖1群仍会保留，其他2~8群暂时不会关闭，但会陆续回收，希望各位群友和各位擂台大侠们可以在新群汇合，一起在新群继续家长里短、捕蜂捉蝶，希望重新汇聚的大江湖游戏群，可以让各群的群友交到更多新朋友。

在整个大江湖项目研发期间，成本问题确实一直困扰着我们。我们不太敢于去尝试接受投资，毕竟是初创团队，也不想扩大团队规模，担心会辜负期待，所以一直保持着小工作室作战的模式。想要揪出我们幕后资本黑手的朋友可以歇歇了，是真的没有。在游戏8月EA上线后，收入曲线肉眼可见的……不太行，收回成本几乎是没太大可能，我们也在担忧下一步该如何考虑。[b]但我们2人从来没想过要放弃大江湖跑路。[/b]
 
在10月把这个情况和凉屋游戏的朋友交流后，我们得到了来自凉屋游戏发出的邀请。从进入游戏行业至今，我一直期待加入一家有更多研发同行的公司，凉屋是我多年前被种草的公司，只是我们感觉自己的项目经验还不太够标准，一直羞于开口。没想到临近不惑之年能得到了这个机会，也没想到，一个看似不太可行的方案，通过与凉屋朋友们的努力，能跨越地域及各种现实问题，最终顺利达成，这是很难用语言表达的开心。
 
在这里非常感谢bilibili游戏的伙伴们的理解，感谢宣发付出的努力。也感谢凉屋游戏的支持，要去继续投入人力物力支持一款暂时还不能盈利的游戏，也许需要带着很大的包容去一起冒险。
 
在这几个月里，感谢那些一直支持过我们的群友，也特别感谢华间弄蝶的李克思同学，时不时代表群友抛来“摸摸鼻子看我们是否断气“般的问候，记得李克思同学时常会说的一句鼓励：[b]像我们这样可以抛开杂念，专注于做自己喜欢的游戏，是非常让人羡慕的。[/b]能在这个各行各业都不太景气的时期，每天在自己家里做着喜欢的工作，是做梦都会笑醒的事情，我们也想过是不是哭穷卖一波惨，但实在没惨可卖。
 
我们在游戏上线受到诸多质疑时都忍住了，闭嘴了，今天想和大家聊这些，也只是希望把真实的情况和群友们小唠一下。希望大家不用记得我们经历的这些，[b]只需要记得大江湖之苍龙与白鸟的正式版本（中原篇）的进度，没有因为任何变化耽误过哪怕1天。[/b]
 
最后，近期大江湖在凉屋同事们的帮助下，正在进行本地化版本的制作，多条路回回血，本地化版本制作期间，也不太能做大的更新，希望老朋友们理解。
 
中原篇的设计工作已经在进行，大方向依然和之前发布的内容一致，堆资源期间没有什么特别具体的饼，一些中原篇的冰渣，希望能让大家提前魂穿西域中原，想象下那里正在发生的故事。

最后，大江湖项目正在扩招人手，欢迎各位神通广大的朋友自荐或推荐身边朋友加入大江湖项目的开发工作：

notes.title: V0.1.17 更新日志 & 正式版更新规划
notes.notes:
[h3]正式版更新计划：
[/h3]
1. 从2022年10月开始，我们将沉下心来，把主要精力放在正式版本的内容开发上，目前已经确定的规划是：
      1）重新梳理战斗系统，新增功法组合及功法克制系统，会新增各类武功附加效果及稀有特性，重新梳理战斗公式，并做好数值平衡
      2）新增装备强化系统和自创武功系统，并考虑新增好感度系统，好感度系统可能触发各江湖人物的隐藏剧情
      3）正式版本除可触发最终结局外，各路江湖人物也可能根据你的选择迎来不同的江湖结局
      4）更多内容将持续规划

2. 在开发正式版本期间，我们也会不定期更新：
      1）如过大家发现有哪里出现BUG或体验不佳可随时反馈，我们会持续优化此类问题
      2）steam成就系统及steam一些集换道具功能也在准备中
      3）挑战系统在确定更好的数值平衡和更有意思的玩法后，也会及时测试发布
      4）如能招聘到合适的异地开发，也会同步尝试手柄适配等体验优化工作

3. 大江湖上线后有很多热心的玩家给我们发来私信鼓励，能看到有那么多希望这类老式武侠游戏的朋友，很开心，同时我们也受到很多质疑，简单回复下：
      1）未来我们也会保持2人全职开发的模式，努力开发和更新并保证中原篇上线
      2）正式版开发期间，我们会定期公布一些开发进展给关心大江湖后续版本的朋友

最后，再次感谢那些在大江湖上线期间，通过B站私信、贴吧、QQ群等渠道给我们发来私信鼓励的玩家们，你们真是一群小天使，也特别感谢在大江湖上线期间为我们做出超详细攻略及剧情解说的大佬们！~
如大家有对正式版本感兴趣的江湖故事，有更关心的角色结局，或想要在正式版中看到的新奇玩法，可以随时给我们留言！

[h3]更新列表：[/h3]
1. 自动战斗：自动战斗时所有弹出框将在1秒后自动消失。
2. 离开迷宫：部分地图场景中按ESC，可直接返回到大地图或山洞洞口（一些迷宫中带剧情的场景为避免触发bug，暂时无法使用该功能）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/043388fa1adb3f3cb1b3dee60d4c37eaca67c544.jpg[/img]

 - 取消包内的装备和武功点击详情按钮，更改为单击选中任意一件装备或物品，将直接弹窗显示装备或武功的属性。
- 背包内替换装备时，点击任意装备，鼠标悬停时会显示当前装备和点选装备的对比信息。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a4529091698bf61d15025d826c6b280f8b452c7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 致歉及优化方案公示！将针对存档、高难度关卡进行调整，更新等级推荐地图
notes.notes:
各位少侠晚上好，

大家在各渠道的评论和意见我们都有持续关注，非常抱歉影响了您的游戏体验。 

我们原先是想做一款经典的老式RPG，因此延续了没有探索引导的机制，只以对话内容为提示，在武功和剧情上也设计了本以为大家也会一样乐在其中的情节，但是上线后才发现实际情况完全不同，主要问题集中在存档的不便捷性、探索有较大的试错成本，以及大家其实并不适应这种缺少引导的探索模式，我们的定位和玩家的实际体验产生了巨大的落差，同时我们也意识到了游戏在各方面确实还存在着不少问题和欠缺，那这些问题就必须被解决掉。
 
也不多说了，今晚先挑出首批大家讨论度最高的几个问题公示调优方案。

[b]1. 角色走路的速度太慢 [/b]
会加快初始走路速度和装备瘦肚小马后的移动速度，今晚更新。

[b]2. 部分关卡难度太高，且进入后无法脱离，几乎坏档。[/b]
- 金凤楼战斗调整：战胜额外获得奖励，战败不会死亡，将继续进行游戏，今晚更新。
- 太湖帮水道调整：进入后可自由离开，明天更新。

[b]3. 存档机制不便捷。[/b]
除大地图、火堆、客栈可存档外，所有的非迷宫地区也都会增加ESC存档功能，包括各类门派地图，城镇，明天更新。

[b]4. 地图难度太过随机，不知道该去哪探索，处处碰壁。[/b]
我们会在江湖志中新增一个地图模块，按M键即可打开，地图中会包含所有场景的推荐探索等级，明天更新。
↓襄阳地区示例，完整的地图文件我们也已经传到额外内容中了，可通过库→选中大江湖→额外内容→手册查看。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/777f9964a856238f47e20a284f8f16a97fd4f8f4.png[/img]

[b]5.希望增加快捷键。[/b]
江湖日志的所有功能将会增加快捷键，其余内容评估中，后续再增添，后天更新。

[b]6. 缺少任务引导。[/b]
我们会在游戏内添加一个临时的对话记录日志，与npc的所有对话将被记录在日志中供查看，上限约能保存500条对话，重新登录时文字内容会被清空，本周内更新。
至于大家说的任务模块功能，这个功能其实是一个开发量非常大的模块，实在是无法在短期内实装，同时这也可能会影响一部分希望纯探索玩家的游戏乐趣，我们会根据大家的后续反馈去谨慎地进行这部分的调整。

已知Bug：
1. 按Esc有概率无法呼出或卡死。
2. 使用罗雀步后无法向左攻击。
3. 游戏黑屏但背景音乐正常播放。
4. 典当装备[武卫甲]后有概率无法替换装备。
5. 部分剧情异常。

上述的反馈只是首批内容，看到大家还有提到了类似钱不够花，数值向的内容调整目前也在规划中，后续依旧会收集意见进行调优。

希望这些改动能有效或暂时满足大家的游戏体验，我们也明白找玩家测试和反馈是非常重要的，非常感谢大家的及时反馈，希望在大家的帮助下，大江湖能变得越来越好，再次诚恳致歉。

[h3][b]基础情报篇：[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:游戏会在哪些地区发售，售价是多少？[/b]
抢先体验将于8月16日11:00登陆Steam，国区定价58人民币。

单周目流程应该在20小时左右，双主线大概30+小时。 


[h3][b]设置篇：[/b][/h3]
[b]Q：游戏是否支持窗口化？[/b]
支持，可以在进入游戏时选择系统设置-全屏/窗口化，同时能调整音量大小。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/3040a6b744c52a8ab0d5ab034a0411108a8b54c0.jpg[/img]

[b]Q：是否支持所有分辨率？带鱼屏能玩吗？[/b]
暂时只支持1920*1080或同比例屏幕，其他屏幕在全屏游戏时上下可能会出现白框，可以尝试在设置中选择窗口化并调整分辨率来解决。

[b]Q：是否支持手柄？[/b]
暂时还不支持，未来会考虑优化，做手柄支持。


[h3][b]新手小攻略篇：[/b][/h3]
[b]Q：游戏如何存档？[/b]
与[u]火堆对话可以进行存档和回血，在游戏大地图中按ESC、或在客栈休息也可以存档[/u]。推荐大家养成多多存档的习惯。

[b]Q：异常状态如何解除？[/b]
大部分异常状态是无法自动解除的，也无法通过在火堆、客栈休息清除。需要[u]使用对应解除状态的道具，或可找江湖郎中替自己解除[/u]。

[b]Q：队伍中最多可携带几人？[/b]
最多可同时带5个队友，超过5人的情况下新加入的队友会自动移到后台待选。可以通过与火堆对话、或在客栈处进行队伍的重新搭配。

[b]Q：如何修炼武功？为什么有些武功无法修炼。[/b]
在武功界面的【修炼武功】处选择想要修炼的武功即可，无法学习/修炼新武功一般是未满足属性条件。等级到达上限后无法继续升级，记得及时更换武功。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a1a746aad920ca1dbda12f0d29bcf32b74346d2e.jpg[/img]

[b]Q：不同站位是否会影响对敌人造成的伤害？[/b]
会！侧面、背面攻击都会有额外加成，请多多尝试。

[b]Q：战斗中如何查看敌人血量和属性？[/b]
长按屏幕可看到头顶血条，将鼠标悬停在角色身上1秒后即可看到详细属性。

[b]Q：战斗中为什么有时候无法攻击？[/b]
小部分系统可能会出现这个问题，试着拖动下屏幕，一般情况就可以继续攻击了

[b]Q：为什么卡在主界面无法进入游戏，或进游戏但开局破庙男子直接把我秒了？[/b]
部分电脑系统所在的区域格式（比如欧洲或其他地区）可能会造成数值异常，中国地区一般不会出现问题，如果遇到这类问题请先尝试修改区域格式至中国地区，正在着手解决中。


[h3][b]Bug反馈篇：[/b][/h3]
[b]Q：遇到Bug怎么办？[/b]
反馈专用群：937707458（禁止水群）
[u]或填写问卷反馈：https://wj.qq.com/s2/10644678/0f71/
[/u]
除问题描述外，请尽量提供以下信息：
系统版本、bug画面截图、触发步骤、分辨率（能提供发生问题时的视频更好）
游戏存档（存档路径: C:\Users\（你的电脑名称）\Documents\TheWorldOfKongFu）

notes.title: EA即将开始前，和大家简单聊聊
notes.notes:
大江湖宣布了抢先体验版定档的消息，看到社群里有很多玩家对我们的情况有疑惑，那就趁此机会和大家一并聊聊。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/a10206f601fcb85cd08419548b9f2e6c770ee226.png[/img]
[h3][b]1. 听说游戏早就开发完了，为什么是采用抢先体验版（EA）上线？[/b]
[/h3]最早我们是计划2021年4月上EA的，当时期望上线的版本是一个大概[u][b]单周目10小时左右的版本[/b][/u]。而目前的版本已经在原有的基础上扩充了一倍的内容量并基本完成了功能以及玩法的开发，目前的EA版本包含双故事主线的《南宋篇》，测试下来[u][b]单周目流程应该在20小时左右，双主线大概30+小时[/b][/u]。

鉴于现在《南宋篇》的内容已经基本开发完了，算是一个比较完整的故事篇章了，同时出于成本控制以及尽早收集大家反馈意见的考虑，我们决定在这个节点先发布抢先体验，这样既能帮我们获取反馈，面向玩家改进并填充更多内容，也能支持我们继续后续的开发工作。


[h3][b]2. 从2020年到今天，2年时间都在干什么？[/b]
[/h3]研发团队是全职，异地，居家开发的。中途加入了一个老大哥， 现在又恢复到2人开发的状态……
这两年，几乎每天都在闷头开发，主要做的就是EA版本南宋篇的故事，优化战斗系统，调整优化数值。做游戏大部分时间是件挺开心的事情，没事加点新支线，加些有意思的小逻辑，测一下觉得挺有意思，都能开心好久。

另外，有些玩家朋友提到我们这两年在做手游？完全没有。目前移动端的版本比较早期，绝大部分的工作都是由外部合作伙伴在负责推进的。所以就算是后期版本，也不会牵涉到我们太多的精力。当然我们之后也会对移动版本进行相应的质量把控，想要购买移动版本的玩家们也不用担心。


[h3][b]3. 之后会采用什么样的更新策略？[/b]
[/h3]游戏上线后我们会定期维护版本，解决bug和一些用户体验上的问题，当版本稳定后就准备进入紧张的《中原篇》沉浸开发中，期间会定期和大家同步一些开发进度，直到《中原篇》上线。


[h3][b]4. EA版本和正式版本区别有多大？[/b]
[/h3]EA版本是发生在南宋地区的襄阳、潇湘、巴蜀、江东等地的故事。
正式版本里会包含我们后续将开发的《中原篇》内容，是发生在中原地区的，包括西域、漠北等地的故事。玩家除了可以继续《南宋篇》两大主线外，还会额外增加新的主线，如各大门派主线和敌对势力主线等，也能学到更多武功。
游戏的整体框架都是一样的，只是EA版本结局时，江湖上的故事还没有结束。但EA版本也会有对应的双主线结局，也会触发二周目，二周目会解锁新的造型和新的初始剧本。
如果非常想要体验完整版的故事可以等正式版再入手，如果愿意先了解南宋篇的故事，可以试试我们的EA版本！


[h3][b]5. 正式版剩余的内容什么时候启动，什么时候上线？[/b]
[/h3]《中原篇》里中原、西域、漠北等地的故事，会在EA版本上线稳定后开始启动。差不多也会是20~30小时的主线内容，包含多个分支和结尾，至少也需要1年的开发周期，从抢先体验版本到正式版本，也就是《中原篇》，已经购买EA版本的用户都可以直接更新获取。


[h3][b]6. 为什么游戏武功从150+缩水到100+？[/b]
[/h3]游戏EA版本武功依然是150个左右，之前想显得谨慎点写成100+了。这个游戏的武功，一定多到你练不过来，所以真的不用太担心武功数量这种问题。在正式版本中，我们也会再次更新更多高星级的武功以及江湖故事供大家游玩。


兜兜转转开发三年，临近上线百感交集， 非常感谢一路以来默默私信鼓励我们的朋友，感谢你们陪我们度过了这段难熬的开发时光，也非常感谢那些在各种平台上给我们留意加油鼓励的朋友，虽然久等，但希望不会让你们失望。

最后，希望大江湖的朋友们都能有一个愉快的夏天！

notes.title: 大江湖游戏日志-0830
notes.notes:
大江湖上线版本的开发已经进入后期阶段，最近这段时间全部精力都在开发，接下来我们不定期在STEAM和B站冒个泡，以免大家时不时敲玻璃担心我们躺尸……(ˊ?ˋ*)


[b]最近玩家反馈了我们一些问题，把玩家反馈比较多的问题整理一下：[/b]

1， 游戏为什么战斗后不掉落金币？大地图和迷宫为什么不能练级？

2， 游戏为什么不能随时存档？

3， 流血中毒DEBUFF是不是太狠了？

4， 游戏什么时候能够上线？（苦瓜脸）


逐个回复一下：

[b]1.    游戏为什么战斗后不掉落金币？大地图和迷宫为什么不能练级？[/b]

老式武侠游戏和传统RPG的设计思路不一样。个人感觉老式武侠的魅力在于刷完美初始和不同路线的多周目游戏，游戏核心是多种搭配的数值养成乐趣。和传统RPG专注一个周目20、30+小时游戏体验不太一样，老式武侠一周目同样需要极长的探索时间，但重度玩家往往会多周目解锁游戏，几周目后可能N小时速通游戏，只为快速培养一个武学路线。这种玩法和传统美式RPG有相似也不完全一样，和日式RPG是完全不同，没有高低之分，只是在我们心里，老式武侠游戏是国产游戏早期特有的一种游戏模式，一种纯粹的数值成长江湖扮演游戏类型，我们很喜欢按照这个思路去设计。


游戏中最重要的如何巧妙获取各类神功利器，打造完美周目，钱和等级不是最重要的资源，但却是完美破局的重要卡点，如何有效规划这些有限的资源合理安排游戏路线是游戏的乐趣之一，所以大江湖中不会提供特别多通过日常积累就可以刷资源的地方，但一定会有奇奇怪怪的神秘高手隐藏在某些山林……海岛……密洞……古墓……地牢……然后提些乱七八糟的要求，给你些宝物或调教你的功夫。当游戏中有大量可以刷资源的地方，就会小小的抵消掉这些江湖奇遇的乐趣，我们会比较慎重去增加各种资源的掉落。


当然我们团队也是各种RPG的重度玩家，前几天我们还在商量要不要增加大地图和迷宫的随机遇敌，毕竟出村后在大地图磨到很高级，进门秒掉初始小BOSS是RPG玩家继SL大法后的第二个看家本领……，我们自己困惑的时候会仔细考虑一下设计初衷，然后做一个取舍。


[b]2.    游戏为什么不能随时存档？[/b]

很多RPG在迷宫中是不能存档的，大家多半能接受这个设计，你可以把大江湖中各个城镇想象成迷宫，因为武侠游戏很多奇遇事件可能发生在酒馆、树林或是一只鸡身上，城镇往往比迷宫凶险数倍，所以……


[b]3.    流血中毒DEBUFF是不是太狠了？[/b]

DEMO版本的武功数值和正式版本的框架会有点不一样，比如DEMO中为了让玩家体验更多终极武学，对很多武功做了临时处理，也增加了很多不高级装备让玩家可以更清晰的体验数值变化，但流血、中毒这些DEBUFF和相关武器确实太BUG了，这点我们测试的不够，之后有时间我们会更新一下，也方便我们自己测试数值。当然我们的主要精力肯定还是放在新框架下的正式版本上，所以如果没太多时间调整DEMO版本现存的问题，也希望大家能理解。


[b]4.    游戏什么时候能够上线？[/b]

问就是……再等等，咳……

现在有朋友在说，游戏已经做好，就等着随时发布，这个重点解释一下，以免到时突然可以发布游戏，大家会问能发了怎么又不及时发？

在不确定上线时间前，我们不会停下开发工作，比如剧情还有很多支线可以展开，武功还有很多待发掘的组合效果，这些是我们一直想做的，有充足的时间肯定是更多的填充我们想要做的小设计，除此之外还有很多特性逻辑或是新的武功特效或新模型新动画的更新工作。最近我们已经自己砍掉了一些可能会比较影响开发周期的功能，也开始了剧情工作的收尾，不管何时我们得到可以上线的通知，我们都会结束现阶段版本，然后调整掉落和战斗数值，开始大量测试。希望大家可以再等等，保持村里通网，上线前我们尽量通知到位(　???) ??
最后聊一个我们自己比较关注的问题：

[b]5.    游戏后面的故事如何发展？[/b]

剧情是最近一年我们3人嗑的时间最久的一块内容。DEMO中展现的剧情内容很少，后面会有很多的江湖门派故事和队友故事。现在已经有玩家提出，DEMO轮番登场的这么多人物根本记不住，未来在某些主线剧情中，会同时登场更多人物，可能更记不住，咳……

在正常的剧情里同时记住排行榜上几百个角色是非常难的，大家可能需要关注一些NPC的闲言碎语，如果这样太复杂了些，大家游戏中关注自己喜欢的角色故事就好了。如果你对整个故事背景和每个门派角色都感兴趣，想去关注很多细枝末节的情节，也许你能发现一个错综复杂的江湖关系网，并应该能发现不少有血有肉的江湖人物。

在设计剧情中也有一些有意思的事情，比如选择南宋背景就是想要一个非黑即白的江湖世界，宋金对抗的大背景，但选择了1150年这个时间线，搜集北方金国的历史，却发现同时期女真族还是有不少有性格有能力的人物，对比之下的大宋就……，所以根据剧情的推进，我们也发现特殊身法和特定性格组合下出现了很多有意思的人物，这些人物不在原本的计划之内，我们也将这些人物都做成了可入队的角色，希望大家能招募到自己喜欢的队友。

我们的角色设计造型出来后，有些原本没什么戏份的角色，突然变得可爱了非~常~多……所以，临时也给这些角色加了点戏……其中就有在DEMO中登场的部分角色。

以上至少能说明我们在整个设计过程中有多随意……所以才会这么慢（不是……

[b]最后，欢迎大家随时和我们联系。我们团队3人比较宅，平时可能不太知道怎么和玩家互动，但如果你私信我们或者给我们写邮件，有时间基本都会回复。
[/b]

做游戏最开心的事除了可以自己研发喜欢的游戏类型外，附加价值就是可以和各种同样喜欢游戏的人去交流，我们对如果修改游戏更赚钱，如何才能改改就会比某某游戏更好的话题不是太感兴趣，但我注意到有很多很有想法的玩家给我们在各种地方留了言，很期待和这些朋友有机会继续闲聊。当年和同学开黑网吧刷夜的我怎么也想不到上了年纪之后，喜欢游戏原来是这么孤独的一件事，所以非常希望能通过大江湖这个游戏，认识更多对游戏有各种想法的朋友，欢迎随时勾搭

如果你有其他希望了解的内容，欢迎留言，咱们争取下次更新日志时唠

notes.title: 发售日延期说明
notes.notes:
各位STEAM的玩家好

[b]"大江湖之苍龙与白鸟"计划延期到2021年4月左右发布[/b]

延期的主要原因是研发中途原本没有奢望能够收到玩家的反馈信息，因此在对现有内容不是很自信的情况下耽误了1-2个月做了一些重构的尝试，好在9-10月份收到了大量玩家的正面反馈，所以也就非常坚定的重新回到了原本的开发模式下。同时参考了一些热心玩家的游戏建议，加上恢复一些之前由于时间不足删除的有意思的功能，游戏计划延期到2021年4月。这段争取来的时间，我们希望能多多完善、测试游戏内容，让下一版本有一个不错的质量和游玩体验。具体消息可以关注我们在其他平台发布的一些图文消息，再次感谢，抱拳。
